identity.title: Studio pane freeze and crash observed through Palmistry; 6.13 threshold and survivor-record schema read from the implementation until stated

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-ARC-027] PALMISTRY BINDING. A Studio pane freeze or crash is observed through Palmistry (Section 6.13). DECLARED GAP, not settled here: Section 6.13 carries no clause ids, states the hung-window threshold only as approximately 5 s and gives no minidump or survivor-record schema. Until Section 6.13 states them, the Studio pane freeze/crash acceptance case reads the Palmistry implementation values `FREEZE_THRESHOLD` = 5 s and `SurvivorRecord { session_id, process_id, stale_ms, minidump_path }`, UNVERIFIED against Section 6.13.
